A terrestrial '''astronomical object'''<ref name="Apocalypse" /> was located in the [[Reo system/Legends|Reo system]], a part of the [[Wild Space]]'s [[Maraqoo sector/Legends|Maraqoo sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Celestial Palace]] of the [[Thuruht]] hive of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], which was the sole sign of civilization in the entire [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The world had a sky lit by its [[Star/Legends|sun's]] orange rays and a blue, dusty plain that grew [[Bush/Legends|scrubs]] and surrounded a [[Unidentified dust-mountain|dust-mountain]] of silt from which the palace rose.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
